label.administrable_evidence: Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)

alignment_dhhs.rationale: The program builds local capacity to operate sustainable programs that will prevent and control housing-related environmental health and safety hazards in low- and very low-income residences, which aligns with the goal of investing in the capacity of partners to overcome persistent health disparities.

alignment_dmva.rationale: The program does not directly align with any DMVA strategic plan objectives.
